::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/objects"}
#docs
Invoices sync to a custom object, which needs HubSpot Enterprise. `missing_scopes` names the custom-object scopes the grant lacks: a connection made before invoice sync must reconnect. `invoice_properties` lists the internal property names the object should carry; only `invoice_id` is required.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The object's id. |
| `data.name` | `string` | The object's name. |
| `data.label` | `string` | The object's label. |
| `missing_scopes` | `array of string` | The missing scopes. |
| `invoice_properties` | `array of string` | The invoice properties. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A list of custom objects |
| `404` | HubSpot is not connected |
| `502` | HubSpot refused the request |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/integrations/hubspot/objects" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
